name: Cróchan
text: Cróchan is a variant spelling of Cruachain. That name belongs to the great royal fortress of Connacht in the saga literature. Medb and Ailill held their court there in the tales of the cattle raid. Readers should follow the Cruachan entry for the fortress and its wonders.

attributes.attribute: name form of the royal fortress of Connacht

okr.objective: Records Cróchan as a spelling variant of Cruachain and points to the fortress entry.
key_results: Names Cruachain as the head form.
Recalls Medb and Ailill holding court in the fortress.
Routes readers to the Cruachan head entry.
